community.aggregateImpactTitle: 90-Day Winter Smog Season Impact (If N Households Participate)
checklist: Replace security guard wood/coal warming tins with electric radiant quartz heaters (₹1,000/gate)
Strict ban on open burning of autumn fallen dry leaves and garden waste in society premises
Coordinate weekly society carpool / metro transit groups for office and school commutes
Equip society maintenance staff with microfiber wet-mops instead of dry brooms for corridors
Seal entry lobbies and stairwell windows after 5:00 PM to prevent chimney-effect infiltration
community.pledgeText: We, the residents of our community, pledge to adopt low-emission routines this winter smog season: avoiding open combustion, shifting to public transit and carpooling, protecting our sanitation staff and security guards with clean warmth, and keeping vulnerable children and seniors safe indoors during inversion spikes.
